nodes.name: Shadow Webhook
nodes.notes: Vincule uma credencial Header Auth exclusiva para a entrada. Não reutilize o segredo interno do SISAG.

nodes.name: Prepare Shadow Input
nodes.notes: Aceita somente request e toolCall. Evidência é sempre recuperada internamente pelo gateway.

nodes.name: Call SISAG Shadow Decision
nodes.notes: Vincule a credencial de saída x-platform-internal-secret. Esta chamada só alcança o gateway read-only.

parameters.jsCode:
const prepared = $('Prepare Shadow Input').item.json;
return { json: { mode: 'shadow', correlationId: prepared.correlationId, accepted: true, gatewayResult: $json, observedAt: new Date().toISOString(), sideEffects: 'none' } };

nodes.name: Record Shadow Observation
nodes.notes: A saída é efêmera no n8n. A API do SISAG registra somente metadados sanitizados, sem headers, telefone, mensagem ou dados da agenda.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { accepted: true, mode: 'shadow', correlationId: $json.correlationId, sideEffects: 'none', decision: { action: $json.gatewayResult.decision.action, toolName: $json.gatewayResult.decision.toolName, reasonCode: $json.gatewayResult.decision.reasonCode, confidence: $json.gatewayResult.decision.confidence, clarificationQuestion: $json.gatewayResult.decision.clarificationQuestion ?? null }, execution: { mode: $json.gatewayResult.execution.mode, provider: $json.gatewayResult.execution.provider, model: $json.gatewayResult.execution.model, promptVersion: $json.gatewayResult.execution.promptVersion, durationMs: $json.gatewayResult.execution.durationMs, errorCode: $json.gatewayResult.execution.errorCode }, toolObservation: $json.toolObservation, answerCandidate: $json.answerCandidate, bookingConfirmationProposal: $json.bookingConfirmationProposal ?? null, bookingCancellationProposal: $json.bookingCancellationProposal ?? null, bookingReschedulingProposal: $json.bookingReschedulingProposal ?? null } }}

nodes.name: Respond Shadow Only
nodes.notes: Confirma apenas a observação sombra ao chamador técnico.

nodes.name: Execute SISAG Read Only Tool

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { request: $('Prepare Shadow Input').item.json.gatewayInput.request, toolCall: { name: $('Record Shadow Observation').item.json.gatewayResult.decision.toolName, arguments: $('Record Shadow Observation').item.json.gatewayResult.decision.toolName === 'scheduling.explain_appointment_status' ? $('Record Shadow Observation').item.json.gatewayResult.decision.toolArguments : Object.fromEntries(Object.entries($('Record Shadow Observation').item.json.gatewayResult.decision.toolArguments).filter(([, value]) => value !== null && value !== undefined)) } } }}

nodes.notes: Executa somente o gateway allowlisted read-only; nenhum dado retornado é enviado ao WhatsApp.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { ...$json, answerCandidate: null, bookingConfirmationProposal: null, bookingCancellationProposal: null, toolObservation: { requested: false, status: 'skipped', errorCode: null, policyVersion: null } } };

nodes.name: Build Answer And Booking Proposal
nodes.notes: Gera proposta efêmera cuja pergunta pode ser enviada pelo SISAG; a execução da reserva permanece bloqueada e exige confirmação posterior.
